Company: This Dot Labs Location: REMOTE (US) Role: Senior Frontend Engineers Experience: 7+ years

We’re growing the team at This Dot Labs and hiring 6–8 senior engineers.

We’re looking for engineers with deep frontend experience who are already thinking about AI as a core part of how software gets built today, not as a side experiment.

This is for engineering leads, architects, and senior engineers with 7+ years of experience who care about strong systems, good judgment, and building software that lasts.

Please email your resume to: jobs@thisdot.co
